events.name: Bash
events.head: Run verify.py and check video, review page and index entry for all 18 tools
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; for t in $(ls journeys | sed 's/\.md//'); do r=$(python3 verify.py $t 2>&1 | tail -1 | cut -c1-90); v=$(ls ../../app/public/wt-review/$t/*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1); d=""; [ -n "$v" ] && d=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height:format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$v" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '); code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8883/wt-review/$t/index.html); in=$(grep -c "\"$t/\|/$t/\|$t/index" ../../app/public/wt-review/index.html); echo "$t | $r | $d| page $code | idx

events.name: Bash
events.head: Probe each review page's video over HTTP for resolution and length
events.input: $ cd [redacted]; for t in $(ls -d */ | tr -d /); do src=$(grep -o -E '(src|href)="[^"]*\.mp4[^"]*"' $t/index.html | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*="([^"?]*).*/\1/'); case "$src" in /*) u="http://localhost:8883$src";; *) u="http://localhost:8883/wt-review/$t/$src";; esac; echo "$t $(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height:format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$u" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; cd [redacted]; git status --short | grep -v '??'
